title: Alfred Krupp and Axel Wenner-Gren in Nassau
summary: JASON tells of Alfred Krupp and Axel Wenner-Gren in Nassau, about 1955 at Nassau, Bahamas, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest named Jason says on Jesse Michels's podcast that, after a gathering he calls the Maison Rouge meeting, a man named Alfred Krupp went down to Nassau in the Bahamas in 1955 with Axel Wenner-Gren, a Swedish multi-billionaire and one of the richest men in the world. He tells it as part of a web of powerful people he believes sits behind the hiding of UFO secrets.
